kapak.alt: Nystagmus direction in the caloric test

youtube.baslik: What happens to the eyes when cold water enters the ear? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the caloric test, water at 30 and 44 degrees Celsius, 7 degrees below and above body temperature, is used. With cold water, nystagmus beats toward the opposite ear, and with warm water toward the same ear (the COWS rule); this holds when the patient is supine with the head raised 30 degrees.
